reserveReview.rationale: Liquity documents BOLD as overcollateralized by WETH, wstETH, and rETH only, with direct redemptions. The configured on-chain adapter's current branch snapshot resolves all three live collateral rows and supplies the point-in-time weights below; those weights remain dynamic and are not treated as permanent composition.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Liquity V2 permitted collateral, official stats, and the configured Ethereum branch snapshot; percentages rounded to one decimal. Refreshed 2026-08-09 from api.liquity.org/v2/ethereum.json (branch coll_value wstETH 42,370,714.84 / WETH 16,640,459.96 / rETH 13,175,569.92 of total_coll_value 72,186,744.73), corroborated by the same branch ActivePool balances the configured adapter reads.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No material collateral row is unclassified in this snapshot; branch weights are point-in-time and may change with protocol activity.

providers.name: Liquity V2 immutable collateral branch contracts

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Collateral is held in immutable on-chain branch contracts rather than a conventional off-chain custodian. The reviewed sources do not establish legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, or rehypothecation terms, so those fields remain unknown.
